title: Diagnostic Review: Distributed PySpark ETL & Shuffle Skew Hygiene
description: Review a distributed PySpark batch processing pipeline for un-salted join skew, accidental cross-join cardinality explosion, and unpartitioned global window shuffles.

artifact.content:
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame, Window
import pyspark.sql.functions as F

def aggregate_market_job_postings(postings_df: DataFrame, employers_df: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    # Step 1: Join job postings with employer metadata
    joined_df = postings_df.join(employers_df, on="employer_id", how="inner")
    
    # Step 2: Cross-category benchmark enrichment
    benchmarks_df = joined_df.join(employers_df.select("tier_grade").distinct())
    
    # Step 3: Compute running cumulative volume metric
    global_window = Window.orderBy("posted_timestamp").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
    result_df = benchmarks_df.withColumn("running_total_inr", F.sum("offered_salary_inr").over(global_window))
    
    return result_df

defects.title: Un-salted Hash Join on Highly Skewed Nullable Key
defects.consequence: Joining on high-cardinality keys with heavy null or top-enterprise concentrations drives massive data skew into single shuffle partitions, triggering task stragglers or executor OOM.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Filter null keys prior to join or apply salt keys (e.g. random salting 0-19) on skewed keys before joining.

defects.title: Unconditional Cross-Join Producing Cartesian Product Explosion
defects.consequence: Invoking DataFrame.join without an explicit predicate executes a Cartesian broadcast nested loop join, multiplying row counts and crashing cluster memory.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Specify an explicit equijoin predicate (on=...) or pre-aggregate dimensional tiers before merging.

defects.title: Unpartitioned Window Frame Forcing Global Single-Partition Shuffle
defects.consequence: Defining Window.orderBy() without partitionBy() forces PySpark to serialize all distributed dataset partitions onto a single executor node.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Add partitionBy('employer_id') or 'location' to distribute window calculation across cluster worker nodes.
